title: PeerShelf
summary: PeerShelf is an academic collaboration platform designed to help students discover, share, and access educational resources.
shortDescription: An academic collaboration platform focused on knowledge sharing and accessible learning.

overview: PeerShelf is an academic collaboration platform designed to help students discover, share, and access educational resources.
The product explores how learning resources can become easier to organize and access through a shared academic experience.
The idea came from a simple student problem: useful learning materials often exist, but they are not always easy to find, share, or revisit.
contribution: Worked across product strategy, product design, user experience, and frontend development.
Built the interface with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI, Firebase, and Zustand.
Structured the product experience around student collaboration, resource sharing, and educational discovery.
Created reusable UI patterns to support a scalable academic collaboration experience.
challenges: The product needed to make student collaboration and resource sharing feel simple.
The experience needed to support discovery, access, and educational usefulness.
The platform had to feel approachable for students while still leaving room for structured resource management.
The interface needed reusable patterns that could support a growing product without becoming difficult to maintain.
approach: Worked across product strategy, user experience, and frontend development.
Focused the interface around resource sharing, academic collaboration, and resource discovery.
Used reusable UI patterns to support a scalable product experience.
Built the product surface with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, ShadCN UI, Firebase, and Zustand.
outcome: PeerShelf became an academic collaboration platform focused on knowledge sharing and accessible learning.
The product gives students a clearer way to think about discovering, sharing, and accessing educational resources.
The frontend foundation supports continued product exploration around learning resources, collaboration, and student-focused discovery.
caseStudy.pullQuote: The product asks how students can discover useful academic resources faster.
